title: Lifeadmin Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeadmin:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day lifeadmin metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on lifeadmin metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It finds what time of day your lifeadmin metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
